connector_labels.description: Site-supplied attribution map pairing a source top-level folder with its registered connector label. Used by data.activity and data.refresh when the chunks table lacks the canonical data_source column and attribution falls back to the source_path top-folder. Axiom ships an empty map; folders without an entry pass through unchanged. Operator-durable home: <config-dir>/data_platform.toml as [[data_platform.connector_labels]] entries.

folder.description: Top-level folder name exactly as it appears in source_path.

connector.description: Registered connector name the folder's documents are attributed to.

data_platform.timeseries.title: Managed time-series tables
data_platform.timeseries.description: Time-series tables this node manages. Declared, never discovered — a table absent from this list is never touched. `engine = "hypertable"` declares the TimescaleDB contract (hypertable, compression by identity, policies; applied by `axi data ensure-schema`); the default engine manages native RANGE(ts) partitions created ahead of the data and optionally retired past a window.

engine.description: `hypertable`: the TimescaleDB contract (time_column, identity, rows_per_day, chunk_interval, compress_after, retain, forward_guard). `partitions`: native range partitions (granularity, ahead, retain_periods).

schema.description: Schema holding the table (the partitioned parent, for the partitions engine).

table.description: The table (the partitioned PARENT, not a partition, for the partitions engine).

time_column.description: hypertable: the column the table is partitioned and ordered on.

identity.description: hypertable: the columns that identify a series. Compression segments by these.

rows_per_day.description: hypertable: the declared rate. The chunk interval is derived from it (about ten million rows per chunk, snapped to 1h..30d); omit for one-day chunks.

chunk_interval.description: hypertable: an explicit chunk width (e.g. 6h, 1d) overriding the derived one.

compress_after.description: hypertable: compress chunks whose newest row is older than this.

retain.description: hypertable: drop chunks older than this. Omit to keep everything; deleting history is never a default.

forward_guard.description: hypertable: this table is the copy the node forwards upstream, so retention runs only while no batch awaits delivery.

ahead.description: Future partitions to keep created. A partition created only once its data arrives is too late — the rows already fell to DEFAULT.

retain_periods.description: Drop partitions entirely older than this many periods. Omit to never drop.
